plan: This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with a second-price payment rule (Vickrey auction). In such an auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy, meaning it's the optimal strategy regardless of what other bidders do. This maximizes my profit in the long run by ensuring I win when my value is higher than the second-highest bid, and I never pay more than my value.

I will bid slightly above my private value to maximize my chances of winning while minimizing the amount I pay. Since the other bidders are rational, they will likely bid close to their own values. Bidding slightly above my value increases my probability of winning against similar bids without significantly increasing my payment if I win. I will bid $16.1.

This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with a twist: the winner pays the second-highest bid. This is a Vickrey auction variant. In such auctions, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy, meaning it's the best strategy regardless of what other bidders do. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth if you win, and bidding lower risks losing a profitable opportunity.
